ai_overview.markdown:
Engagement season runs from **late November through mid-February** , starting around Thanksgiving and wrapping up after Valentine’s Day.[[1]](https://www.millsjewelers.com/blogs/blog/welcome-to-engagement-season-when-47-of-marriage-proposals-take-place)[[2]](https://www.thebarn305.com/when-is-engagement-season/)

### Why It Happens Then

- **Family time:** Couples see family and friends during the holidays, making it easy to celebrate in person.
- **Holiday magic:** Lights, time off work, and festive moods create a romantic setting.
- **Top proposals:** December is the busiest month, with Christmas Day ranked as the most popular day to propose.[[1]](https://www.theknot.com/content/things-to-know-for-proposal-season)[[2]](https://www.brides.com/engagement-season-popular-months-for-proposals-8750029)[[3]](https://www.familyjewelers.com/blog/2025/Dec/18/welcome-engagement-season-when-47-marriage-proposa/)[[4]](https://www.millsjewelers.com/blogs/blog/welcome-to-engagement-season-when-47-of-marriage-proposals-take-place)

Read more about planning on [The Knot](https://www.theknot.com/content/things-to-know-for-proposal-season) or check out [Brides](https://www.brides.com/engagement-season-popular-months-for-proposals-8750029) for proposal month trends.[[1]](https://www.brides.com/engagement-season-popular-months-for-proposals-8750029)[[2]](https://www.theknot.com/content/things-to-know-for-proposal-season)
